operator.side_effect_boundary: APPLIED and REPLAYED use status-specific runtime-scope-bound handler receipts and require the exact durable HardState event. NO_CHANGE uses its own status-specific receipt, requires no event and reports side_effects_executed=false. Response loss, success=false or attribution failure after the HardState call must first reopen the exact event: an existing commit becomes REPLAYED, an uncertain read remains PENDING with RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and UNKNOWN regardless of ordinary max attempts, and only authoritative absence may enter ordinary failure. Historical replay never re-executes the effect, including after more than 1000 newer events.
operator.startup_recovery_boundary: Governed admission activates only after the shared Acceptance Effect owner drains recovery work and proves no PENDING or CLAIMED effect remains.
operator.shutdown_boundary: Operator ingress drains first, then Scheduler producers stop, Task Runtime closes the shared Acceptance Effect owner, Workspace quiesces, mode-transition dependencies stop, command/security stores close, and app references clear last. A live OBS, Scheduler or Task Runtime close failure preserves dependencies and published references and returns a stable retry-required error.
